model_annotation:
This diagram represents the distribution of enterprises, employment and net turnover across various industries, specifically construction, trade, and services in 2021. The diagram comprises three donut charts, each representing a different category. The donut charts are divided into four sectors each: industry, construction, trade, and other services. For the number of enterprises, the "other services" sector is the largest at 61%, followed by "industry" at 19%, "trade" at 12%, and "construction" at 8%. For the number of persons employed, "other services" is again the largest sector at 51%, followed by "industry" at 21%, "trade" at 19%, and "construction" at 9%. For turnover, "trade" is the largest sector at 33%, followed by "other services" at 31%, "industry" at 33%, and  "construction" at 3%. All charts contain a legend beneath them and include percentage labels within each sector. The sectors are color-coded, with "industry" represented by brown, "construction" by gray, "trade" by red, and "other services" by blue. 
The three donut charts are arranged sequentially.
